awards.name: Boston College Carroll Full-Time MSF Merit Scholarships / Fellowships
awards.description: All domestic and international applicants to the full-time MSF (and MSA/MBA) are considered for merit-based scholarships or fellowships. Award decisions communicated with admission. Scholarship amounts range from $7,500 to full tuition for exceptional candidates. For Full-Time MSF and MSA entering Fall 2026 class stats: more than 95% of class received merit scholarships/fellowships; awards disbursed once a semester for two semesters (Fall and Spring). Graduate Assistantships may be offered in combination with scholarships (stipend for research/admin). Includes Dean's Scholarships for exceptionally strong MSF candidates. Page does not restrict merit by Regular vs Quantitative Finance track.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Carroll full-time MSF students (Regular or Quant/STEM track). Explicitly open to domestic and international applicants. Distinct from MBA-only named fellowships (GWIB, ROMBA, Weiss MBA/MSW preference).
awards.amount: $7,500 to full tuition (class: >95% of FT MSF receive some merit; exact offer unpublished until admission)
awards.note: STEM designation is Quant track only — funding language is not track-limited. Do not merge with MBA ROMBA/GWIB. overlapsWithExisting: none BC-MSF-specific in SCH-015–106.

awards.name: Boston College John J. McMullen Fellowship (US Naval Academy)
awards.description: Recognizes exceptional full-time MBA, MSF, or dual MBA/MSF candidates who graduated from the United States Naval Academy. May grant full tuition remission for up to two years (20 months). Considered through Admission Committee review.
awards.eligibility: US Naval Academy graduates only — not a general intl HK/TW/PRC award.
awards.amount: Up to full tuition remission (≤2 years / 20 months)
awards.note: ingest:false — alumni/service-academy pathway, not open intl merit pool.

awards.name: Claremont Graduate / Drucker School Fellowships (incl. MS Finance)
awards.description: CGU merit-based fellowships awarded on academic department recommendation. Offered based on enrollment in 12–16 units each semester; adjusted if enrollment changes; honored through required coursework if SAP maintained. Drucker School FAQ: disperses $500,000 annually in fellowships; 85% of Drucker students receive some level of fellowship. Priority application deadlines maximize fellowship consideration. Citizenship not restricted on fellowship pages.
awards.eligibility: Admitted CGU / Drucker students including MS in Finance. Apply by priority deadlines for max fellowship consideration. FAFSA is for US federal aid (domestic).
awards.amount: Not published per student (pool $500k/year school-wide; 85% of Drucker students receive some fellowship)
awards.deadline: Priority deadlines with admission (Fall 2027 priority Feb 1, 2027)
awards.note: General CGU/Drucker fellowship — not an MBA-only card. Amounts unpublished.

awards.name: Illinois Gies MSF Merit Scholarships
awards.description: MSF program offers a limited number of scholarships to program participants, with emphasis on recruiting high-caliber students from diverse backgrounds. All students are considered for Merit Scholarships. Decisions shortly after admission decisions; recipients notified via email. No separate scholarship application described. Citizenship not restricted on page.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Gies MSF students. Limited awards; competitive.

awards.name: Ohio State Fisher SMF Merit-Based Cash Awards
awards.description: All admitted SMF applicants are automatically considered for merit-based scholarships; no separate application. Limited merit-based cash awards to select incoming students may range from $6,000 to $18,000. Recipients notified prior to admissions response deadlines. Apply early — Priority 1 (Dec 11, 2026) and Priority 2 (Feb 19, 2027) for merit consideration; funds limited.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Fisher Specialized Master in Finance students. Page does not restrict by citizenship.
awards.deadline: With admission; priority deadlines Dec 11, 2026 and Feb 19, 2027 for aid consideration
awards.note: Published cash range — rare among Batch3 auto merits.

awards.name: Ohio State Fisher SMF Graduate Assistantship
awards.description: SMF awards up to one Graduate Assistant appointment each year. GA is 10 hours/week and provides a 50% tuition waiver plus a monthly stipend. All admitted applicants automatically considered; no separate application. Subject to annual financial-aid budget.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Fisher SMF students; extremely limited (≤1/year).
awards.amount: 50% tuition waiver + monthly stipend (stipend $ not published on page)

awards.name: Michigan State Broad MSF Financial Support
awards.description: Broad states that 40% of non-sponsored M.S. in Finance students receive financial support. Questions about financial aid addressed during the application process. Dollar amounts, separate application steps, and citizenship limits are not detailed on the recoverable tuition-page text (live tuition URL Incapsula-blocked; language confirmed via Wayback). Undergraduate Finance department endowed scholarships are UG-only — not this card.
awards.eligibility: Non-sponsored admitted Broad MSF students (40% receive some support per program tuition messaging). Citizenship not stated as restricted in recovered text.
awards.amount: Not published (40% of non-sponsored students receive support)
awards.note: Source recovery: Wayback + program overview. Re-verify live tuition page when Incapsula clears.

awards.name: UC San Diego Rady MQF Merit Scholarships
awards.description: Rady provides limited scholarship support to exceptional individuals. All domestic and international admitted students are considered for merit-based scholarship upon admission; no additional application required. Donor-supported named fellowships (e.g., Brandes, Anklesaria, Fellows for the Future, Silberman, Alicia and Erwin Milan Family) may require completing the Financial Assistance section / short answer by the program Fellowship Deadline — several are framed for outstanding graduate students (some MBA-named awards are MBA-only; do not merge those).
awards.eligibility: Admitted Rady MQF (ucsd-msf) students. Explicitly domestic and international. UC undergraduate pathway award is separate (SCH-115).
awards.amount: Limited; amounts not published (except UC Scholarship pathway $10,000 — separate card)
awards.deadline: With admission (named fellowships: Fellowship Deadline on application)
awards.note: Program renamed MFin → MQF; card attaches to catalog id ucsd-msf.

awards.name: Rady UC Scholarship ($10,000 — UC campus graduates)
awards.description: All graduates of any University of California campus are eligible for the Rady-funded UC Scholarship in the amount of $10,000.
awards.eligibility: Graduates of any UC campus only — not open to typical HK/TW/PRC applicants without a UC bachelor's.
